purpose.zh: 拉开前腿大腿后面，给前后劈叉打底子
purpose.en: Stretches the back of your front thigh as a first step toward the front splits.

text.zh: 屁股往后坐，前腿伸直，背拉长
text.en: Sit your hips back, straighten your front leg, keep your back long

text.zh: 后膝跪地，前脚后跟着地、勾脚尖。
text.en: Back knee down, front heel on the floor, toes up.

text.zh: 前脚勾起来，大腿后面会拉得更明显。
text.en: Flex your front foot to feel more in the back of your thigh.

text.zh: 呼气时屁股再往后坐一点，背别弓。
text.en: Each breath out, sit your hips back a little more without rounding.

commonErrors.zh: 脑袋往脚尖凑，背弓成虾米
commonErrors.en: Reaching your head to your toes and curling your back.

commonErrors.zh: 前膝死死锁直，膝盖后面扯着疼
commonErrors.en: Locking the front knee hard so the back of it hurts.

cautions.zh: 跪着的膝盖下面垫个软垫
cautions.en: Put a soft pad under your kneeling knee.

cautions.zh: 大腿后面疼就少往后坐点，还疼就停
cautions.en: If the back of your thigh hurts, don't sit back as far. Stop if it still hurts.
